payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_regate.py::test_review_commit_diff_starts_a_restacked_branch_at_the_packaged_commits_copy stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/regate.py. The claim was "`review_commit_diff` starts a restacked branch's range at the packaged commit's rebased copy, as `commit_review._rebased_copy` finds it, when `pushed_sha` is no ancestor of `head`. The kept paths and the text follow the rule of the criterion above. The witness rebases the packaged commit onto the moved `main` and adds a review commit that edits tests/test_w.py. The original packaged commit stays reachable from another branch, so the checkout still holds it. The witness asserts the returned diff's paths are exactly tests/test_w.py. It asserts the text equals the test's own `DIFF_FLAGS` diff of the copy to that head over that one path.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_regate.py::test_review_commit_diff_keeps_the_review_commits_paths_the_task_also_changed, tests/test_saffron_gates.py::test_the_fast_gates_name_their_tool_and_pass_on_a_clean_tree[lint], and the criterion's witness did not fail.
